name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Since 2004 Blackstone Saunas manufactures its products with the main objective to bring health and wellness to every customer. Infrared Saunas are the best proved way to achieve better health, there are many benefits Infrared Therapy brings: from detoxifying and beautifying the body to relieving stress and aiding the body in healing after various injuries.



Each Infrared sauna session can also help with relaxing after a hard day at work, fight depressions, aid with weight loss, improve circulation and blood pressure, relieve aching muscles and joints and assist with sleeping troubles.



Blackstone uses exclusive Eco friendly Carbon heaters with low EMF – first ones and the safest on the market, combining unique new technology with environmentally friendly materials to make the perfect Infrared Sauna for indoor use to bring joy and various benefits during each sauna use.
